_about: NFTT series: posts serialized isomorphically, one methodological pipeline run on different subjects. Part order and roles are the author's own, from the series map in tuning-into-the-distortion-field (published 2026-09-11, PR #411); the recoil role is that post's own eyebrow; the last three glosses are each post's own index description. Rendered into each post and the index by scripts/nftt_series.py and scripts/nftt_index_build.mjs.

serialized-thread.title: The serialized thread
serialized-thread.method: The discipline that makes the series legible is the same whether the subject is a custody clause or a piece of slang: name the mechanism, then state plainly what would prove you wrong.
serialized-thread.coda: Each entry states its own falsifier. Read together they are the topography: not one call, but the inference quality across the series.
